# pcd_networking_router_interface (Resource)

Attaches a subnet (or existing port) to a Neutron router. Immutable: any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-network"
}

resource "pcd_networking_subnet" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  name       = "tf-example-subnet"
  cidr       = "10.0.0.0/24"
}

resource "pcd_networking_router" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-router"
}

resource "pcd_networking_router_interface" "example" {
  router_id = pcd_networking_router.example.id
  subnet_id = pcd_networking_subnet.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (String) The router to attach to.

### Optional

- `port_id` (String) An existing port to attach (mutually exclusive with subnet_id).
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `subnet_id` (String) The subnet to attach (mutually exclusive with port_id).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The interface port ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_router_interface.example <id>
```
